desc: Operated as an independent consultant delivering end-to-end software services spanning development, quality assurance, and technical advisory.
Designed and developed web applications and systems using native PHP, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML, alongside CodeIgniter, jQuery, and Bootstrap.
Built a portfolio of web-based products including educational games, a Management Information System, an E-Library System, a gallery, and blogs.
Served as QA across multiple project-based software deliveries, defining test scenarios and acceptance criteria and executing unit, smoke, regression, and acceptance testing.
Advised and consulted on client-developed systems, analyzing and evaluating them to improve design and existing functionality.
Produced test documentation and performed unit and assembly testing as a software test engineer.
Managed a Discord community server and social media channels, handling content posts, customer chats, and queries.
Provided instruction and tutoring services.
Delivered video editing services.
Software Engineer Intern turned Web Developer utilizing Wordpress, Git, AngularJS, NodeJS, CodeIgniter, and Laravel.
Teaching computer programming and IT-related courses to college and senior high school students.
Administrative work such as resource scheduling, standard template creation, organization management, project planning, and managing school page and group, and other social media accounts.
Managed tickets, tasks, code, version control, and production releases of API, LITE, and AMI. (JIRA, Git)
Database administrative work such as checking and killing table locks, creating and documenting database change tickets, query optimizations, and indexing. (MySQL)
Led initiatives to improve projects across UI, UX, discussion processes, and code standards.
Improved existing database structures, refactored legacy code, and revised team task and ticket processes.
Spearheaded multiple teams and managed their expectations.
Served as a backup and support developer on other projects. (AngularJS, NodeJS, Laravel)
Took on additional roles beyond core responsibilities to fill team gaps.
Built and deployed startup applications from scratch, handling both frontend and backend development.
Collaborated closely with the Project Manager to test, review, and validate application features before release.
Assisted in project planning by breaking down features into development tasks and estimating implementation timelines.
Documented APIs, development workflows, and analytics to support team collaboration and future maintenance.
Worked on 7 applications across government and commercial clients.
Served as main or sole developer on most projects and supporting developer on 2.
Performed development, system and business analysis, code reviews, testing, QA, deployment validation, troubleshooting, and production support.
Participated in requirements analysis, client sessions, and product demonstrations.
